title: Hale Ho'omaka | KEY.co
description_expanded: Designed for comfort and convenience, each bedroom offers ensuite-style access, including a cozy loft with convertible twin beds and a nearby half bath. A queen sleeper sofa adds extra flexibility for families or small groups. Located within Sandpiper Village, guests enjoy access to a pool, hot tub, and BBQ pavilion, along with walkable access to golf, shops, and dining. Just a short drive from Hanalei Bay’s golden shores, this retreat offers the ideal balance of resort amenities and laid-back island comfort.
